title: Literature-bound FMC full surface-accounting preflight
purpose: Qualify conservative atmospheric-side FMC state transitions and water accounting before any SWAP infiltration trajectory comparator is allowed.

predecessor_authority.D12: FMC/SMVE equation preflight passed; B01 200-bin discretization and maximum 10 s process step frozen.
predecessor_authority.D13: Groundwater-front branch retained bounded research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D14: Eq.18 infiltration-front and Eq.19 falling-slug kinematics plus conservative capillary relaxation passed.
predecessor_authority.implication: D15 changes no D12-D14 kinematics. It adds only finite-volume allocation and state-transition accounting needed to close the atmospheric-side ledger.

primary_authority.citation: Talbot and Ogden (2008), A method for computing infiltration and redistribution in a discretized moisture content domain
retained_rules: surface input volume equals prescribed flux times dt
water is introduced sequentially from lower-water-content left bins toward right bins
existing wetting fronts consume water according to calculated front advance
dry-bin initiation uses a Green-Ampt successive-approximation depth with 0.0005 cm depth convergence
residual surface water after the rightmost bin is ponding or runoff according to boundary condition
primary_authority.superseded_rule: D15 does not use the 2008 capillary-weighted redistribution operator; Ogden et al. 2015 supersedes that process with capillary relaxation.

primary_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2015), A new general 1-D vadose zone flow solution method
retained_rules: falling slugs are created when rainfall/snowmelt/ponding is insufficient to support calculated connected-front advance
Eq.19 translates falling slugs under gravity
falling slugs merge with deeper groundwater fronts on contact
capillary relaxation is zero-dimensional finite-volume reorganization and must conserve mass exactly

accounting_primitives.partial_existing_front_rule: if remaining supply is smaller than demand, advance only by remaining_supply/dtheta and exhaust surface supply

dry_bin_activation.activation_rule: activate only when remaining surface supply >= dtheta*z_dry; subtract exactly dtheta*z_dry

overflow.no_ponding_case: all residual after rightmost-bin capacity becomes runoff
overflow.finite_surface_store_case: surface store cap = Ksat*dt; fill store first and send excess to runoff

accounting_primitives.hiatus_detachment: a surface-connected wetted interval [0,z] becomes a falling slug [0,z] with unchanged finite-volume water before Eq.19 translation
accounting_primitives.slug_translation: D14 Eq.19; top and bottom translate by identical distance within each bin
accounting_primitives.slug_groundwater_merge: on exact contact or overlap with same-bin groundwater water, replace disjoint/overlapping intervals by their finite-volume union; any geometric overlap is counted once before and after merge
accounting_primitives.capillary_relaxation: D14/Ogden-2015 conservative ordering operation; no water source/sink
accounting_primitives.ledger: initial column water + surface input + initial surface store = final column water + final surface store + runoff

synthetic_tests.state: D14 I_MID front geometry; all bins surface-connected
synthetic_tests.requirement: sequential allocation exhausts finite supply without negative remaining water; column storage increment equals infiltrated surface withdrawal to <=1e-14 cm

synthetic_tests.state: bin 101 dry at surface; bins 102..199 ignored for this isolated initiation test
synthetic_tests.requirement: Green-Ampt dry-bin root is finite; activation depth satisfies root residual <=1e-12 cm; debited water equals dtheta*z_dry; ledger residual <=1e-14 cm

synthetic_tests.state: all active bins filled from surface to D=160 cm
synthetic_tests.requirement: test no-ponding and finite-store branches; infiltration plus final store plus runoff equals supplied water to <=1e-14 cm

synthetic_tests.state: three selected surface-connected bin intervals with frozen depths 15, 30 and 45 cm
synthetic_tests.requirement: detachment changes no water; one Eq.19 step preserves every slug length and total finite-volume water to <=1e-14 cm

synthetic_tests.state: synthetic same-bin falling slug contacts a same-bin groundwater-filled interval
synthetic_tests.requirement: finite-volume union is non-overlapping, physical and preserves the unique occupied water length to <=1e-14 cm

synthetic_tests.state: synthetic multi-bin connected fronts plus falling slugs with deliberately non-monotone front ordering
synthetic_tests.requirement: relaxation restores monotone connected-front ordering and leaves total column finite-volume water unchanged to <=1e-14 cm

synthetic_tests.state: synthetic 10 s sequence combining finite supply, one dry-bin activation opportunity, partial final-bin advance, hiatus detachment, slug translation and finite surface store
synthetic_tests.requirement: global water ledger closes to <=1e-14 cm without clipping, hidden correction or full-order fallback

D16_gate.if_positive: Authorize D16 only to preregister an exposed homogeneous-B01 surface-infiltration/hiatus development comparator against R16 and R2, using D12-D15 frozen bins, substep, kinematics and accounting.
D16_gate.if_negative: Close atmospheric-side FMC comparator route without retuning bin count, substep, Green-Ampt activation rule, accounting order, or synthetic cases.
